one_liner: Xero is a cloud-based accounting platform providing APIs for integrating with accounting workflows and financial operations.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is the primary authentication method. Custom Connections use OAuth2. Bearer tokens available for multi-account scenarios.

access.notes: Free developer signup, no credit card required. Usage-based pricing model in effect from 2026-03-02 for multi-connection apps, but single-client bespoke integrations and custom connections remain exempt.

evidence.snippet: Create your Xero account to get up and running with Xero API. No credit card required
Sign up for a free account to build on the Xero platform.
Bespoke Integrations for Accountant and Bookkeepers built for your own practice or a single client are exempt
A Model Context Protocol server allows Clients to interact with Xero

buildability.rationale: Composio toolkit with 109 tools already exists, self-serve free credentials available, official MCP server published, and documented API.

unknown_reasons.api_surface: Rate limit policy not stated in provided pages; OpenAPI spec URL exists but not linked
